codeReview.summary: The feature replaces naive colon splitting with URL-aware parsing and adds broad tests, but there is a blocking parsing bug: scheme-based URLs with port numbers are incorrectly split as if the port/path were a branch.

issues.description: In split_source_and_branch(), scheme URLs use the last ':' after '://' as the branch delimiter. This misparses valid URLs containing a port (e.g., `myrepo:https://github.com:8443/org/repo`) into source `https://github.com` and branch `8443/org/repo` even when no branch is provided. This violates the requirement that only a ':' not part of the URL should delimit branch.
